title: Breaking the Reasoning Barrier A Survey on LLM Complex Reasoning through the Lens of Self-Evolution
paper_type_zh: 复杂推理自我演化综述
best_for_zh: 设计合成推理数据流程或研究迭代式模型改进的读者。
one_line: An ACL survey of growing reasoning ability by jointly improving training data and models.
从数据演化、模型演化和循环改进理解复杂推理能力的 ACL 综述。
why: It gives readers a compact way to reason about where iterative reasoning systems obtain data, quality signals, and real improvements.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 ACL Findings survey directly focused on how reasoning data is generated, filtered, used for training, and improved in repeated cycles.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning systems often improve by generating new examples, filtering them, training a stronger model, and repeating. The difficulty is that every stage can either add useful signal or quietly recycle an earlier mistake. This ACL survey frames the problem through data evolution, model evolution, and the cycles that combine them.
推理系统常通过生成新样本、筛选样本、训练更强模型、再重复这一过程来提升能力。困难在于每一步既可能增加有效信号，也可能悄悄重复前一轮错误。该 ACL 综述从数据演化、模型演化及二者组合的循环来描述问题。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The key contribution is a reader-friendly separation of three levers. Data evolution asks how new reasoning examples become more useful; model evolution asks how training increases capability; self-evolution asks what happens when these levers are iterated together. This separation prevents an observed gain from being attributed vaguely to “more self-improvement.”
关键贡献是把三个杠杆清楚拆开。数据演化讨论新推理样本怎样变得更有用；模型演化讨论训练怎样提升能力；自我演化讨论两者反复结合后发生什么。这样可以避免把观察到的提升笼统归因于“模型会自己进步”。

title: Method
方法
html: When using the taxonomy, record one round as a complete unit: seed tasks, generated traces, filters or rewards, the model update, and evaluation on held-out tasks. Then compare rounds rather than only the first and last model. The paper is a synthesis, not a released pipeline, so implementation details and data licenses remain properties of the primary methods.
使用这套分类时，应把一轮过程完整记录下来：种子任务、生成过程、筛选或奖励、模型更新、留出任务评测。然后比较每一轮，而不只看第一个和最后一个模型。本文是综合研究，并未发布可直接运行的流程，因此实现细节和数据许可仍属于原始方法。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract explicitly says that data evolution covers higher-quality reasoning training data, model evolution covers training strategies, and their iterative cycles define self-evolution. It also discusses scaling behavior and representative O1-like work. These claims make the paper a useful comparison frame, while each numerical improvement still requires the primary paper's data and evaluation setup.
官方摘要明确说明：数据演化研究如何获得更高质量的推理训练数据，模型演化研究提升能力的训练策略，二者的迭代循环构成自我演化；文中还讨论扩展行为及代表性的 O1 类工作。这些信息使它成为很好的比较框架，但任何数值提升仍要回到原始论文的数据和评测设置。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Instead of treating data generation and post-training as unrelated chapters, the survey puts their feedback loop at the center. For reasoning-data work, that is the important shift: a trace is not just an example to store; it is an input to the next model and therefore needs provenance, quality criteria, and a comparison that checks whether the loop truly improved the task.
本文不把数据生成和后训练当作互不相干的章节，而是把二者的反馈循环放在中心。对推理数据工作而言，这一点很重要：过程不只是要存储的样本，它还会成为下一轮模型的输入，因此需要记录来源、质量标准，以及检验循环是否真正提升任务的比较方式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Repeated generation can amplify a systematic error, and a filter that prefers familiar answers can reduce diversity. Reported gains may also hide changes in test distribution, compute, or teacher strength. The paper organizes these risks but cannot supply one quality rule that fits every reasoning domain.
反复生成可能放大系统性错误，偏好熟悉答案的筛选器也可能降低多样性。报告的提升还可能混入测试分布、计算量或教师模型强度的变化。本文能整理这些风险，却不能提供适合所有推理领域的一条质量规则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card to plan a small iterative data experiment. Before running it, decide what is kept from each round, who or what judges trace quality, and which fixed tasks remain untouched for comparison. That simple record makes it possible to tell whether a later model improved because of better reasoning data rather than because the evaluation became easier.
可用这张卡规划一个小型迭代数据实验。开始前先决定：每轮保留什么，谁或什么来判断过程质量，哪些固定任务始终不参与训练、只用于比较。这样的记录才能区分后续模型是因推理数据更好而提升，还是评测变容易了。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: For each surveyed system, draw a loop with five boxes: task source, trace generator, filter, trainer, and evaluator. Label the information that moves across each arrow. If an arrow has no quality check, write that down as an open question. This exercise turns a broad survey into an actionable design review for a student project.
对每个被综述的系统画五个方框：任务来源、过程生成器、筛选器、训练器、评测器，并标注每条箭头传递的信息。如果某条箭头没有质量检查，就把它写成开放问题。这个练习能把宽泛的综述变成学生项目可执行的设计检查。
